title: Zachary Durham Out With "Play My Part" For Happy People
htmlContent:
Zachary is an R&B artist who has had his sound on people's lips due to his lyrics, which sometimes resonate with most listeners. He represents Brooklyn and the United States as a whole.

His newest song, "Play My Part," features a sound centered around commercial music and adult contemporary genres, combining a calm and applying beat in which the artist delivers verses that capture the attention of many people looking for a good melody to relax to while taking a break.

Stream "Play My Part" on Spotify
